_description: Maps trigger phrases to domain CLAUDE.md files for context loading. 'state' is the domain lifecycle: active | dormant | complete | killed | archived. Do NOT execute a domain's Check workflow unless state is 'active' — surface the state instead. 'nested_git' marks domains that are their own gitignored git repo inside this repo (other-worlds pattern), with a compatibility symlink at code_alias. Optional 'meeting_routing' makes a transcript processor auto-file meeting transcripts to the domain: email_domains (participant handle domains), people (full names), company_names, title_keywords are match signals; filing.correspondence_dir is the stub destination (repo-relative). Only active domains participate.
